purpose: Tripo image-to-3D single building pilot; no generated 3D model yet
status: concept reference, not surveyed Canton Road facade or accepted production asset

review.accepted_for: single front-right view; whole building; four storeys; two shops; neutral background; blank signs; clear projecting awnings and recessed windows
limitations: Rendered stylized material is not a final pixel texture atlas
Visible weathering and contact shading may be baked into reconstructed color
Dimensions and topology still require calibration after reconstruction
No confirmation yet that small pipes and brackets reconstruct cleanly
